**Pull request #4162 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# PR #4162: Patch: /stats' Tokens and Other created cards match the deck table, rows open the card, and the page loses its explanatory paragraphs

Closes #4155

## What changed and why

Issue #4155, per its plan: the `/stats` Tokens and Other created cards sections now show the deck table's columns (Card thumbnail, Name, Games, Tier, Adjusted, Win rate) in its order, with its cell markup and classes, honouring the Columns toggle; Used, Not used, Used Radiant, Used normal and Used vs not used (plus `formatPlayedDelta`, `rateText`, `CreatedTiersNote`, `pointsText` and the panel's `field` prop) are gone. A Created row opens the same drill-down as a deck row (`openDrillDown`, `?card=`, Back/Escape close). All seven explanatory paragraph groups are deleted (tiers note, ranges note, Created hint + tiers line, Games counted line, Sets intro + footnote, Players note), with their CSS, test ids and 19 `zh-CN` strings; error, empty, loading and collecting states stay. Recorded as ruling R4155000 (`spec/rulings/R4155000.md`, `spec/pending/4155.md`), amending nine notes and §9.11. No server, endpoint or tally changes.

## How I tested it

- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/stats/CreatedPanel.test.tsx` — 11 passed (new R4155000 header/toggle/row-open tests; sorting still R3184002, default still Adjusted best-first).
- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/routes/stats.test.tsx` — 92 passed, including 3 new R4155000 tests: token row click opens the drill-down with face, figures and `?card=`, The Coin row opens via Enter with figures and empty deck-only states (no face, no error), Escape closes; Games toggle hides Games in both Created tables; no removed paragraph renders on any tab.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/stats/GamesPanel.test.tsx src/stats/model.test.ts src/i18n/i18n.test.ts` — 30 passed.
- `cargo jackioh spec check` — ok (2241 rulings, 5684 proofs). `pnpm exec eslint apps/web` — clean. `cargo fmt --check` — clean. `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` — clean (see note below). Grep over `e2e/` for removed testids/strings — no hits.

## Decisions the issue did not settle

- **Drill-down, not the CardDetail inspect view**, for token rows: catalog token defs render faces, and The Coin (no catalog def) shows its figures with the existing empty-state strings, so no server change was needed. Stated in the ruling.
- **No `title` tooltips on the Created headers**: the deck's Adjusted tooltip describes drawing a card, which is wrong for made cards; the issue only required keeping tooltips already on headers.
- **Name cell is now `td` like the deck table** (was `th scope=row`); **games cell renders raw** like the deck table (identical text to `formatNumber` for these values).
- `GamesPanel.test.tsx` joined the ruling's `proven_in` since its R4155000 absence test proves the removal. R0654 and R3324003 were deliberately left unamended (their sentences state live rules/history, not removed notes).

## For the reviewer

- Typecheck OOMs this box's default node heap (`tsc` core-dumps, exit 134, twice); it passes with `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096`. That looks like a pre-existing environment limit, not the change — flagging in case CI shows otherwise.
- The Created rows' `role="button"` means they are no longer `row` roles: test helpers read them via `tbody tr`, matching the deck-table tests.

### Its own review

Built and checked on `muse`. This is a draft while its own review run, on the same subscription, reviews it adversarially and fixes what it finds (up to 3 rounds); CI runs on it meanwhile. Once that review approves it, it is marked ready and auto-merge turns on.

<details><summary>Rounds and checks</summary>

| Round | Builder | Checks | Review |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | build, 43.6 min | green | - |

| Gate | Result | Time |
|---|---|---|
| rustfmt (`cargo fmt --check`) | pass | 13s |
| catalog (`cargo jackioh catalog check`) | pass | 0s |
| patches (`cargo jackioh patches check`) | pass | 5s |
| rulings (`cargo jackioh spec check`) | pass | 5s |

</details>

---
Built overnight by @jgoetzmann-bot ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44221780077)); every run on it, step by step, is in its [journal](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/_bot-journal/4155.md). Comment `@jgoetzmann-bot <what to change>` or `/harness revise <notes>` to ask for a revision, or `/harness stop` to stop it.
```
